battle.name: 第一次希土戰爭
battle.theater: 色薩利平原與愛琴海東岸
battle.brief: 一八九七年四月至七月，希臘王國以克里特統一運動為由把主力推入鄂圖曼的色薩利平原，與鄂圖曼方面軍在維列斯提諾、卡爾迪察、阿爾米羅斯與多莫科斯連戰，把鄂圖曼軍逐回色雷索斯山以北。卡面的線膛野戰砲到這一年已被後膛式鋼砲取代，只留守備與訓練序列，雙方火力已由新式速射砲與連發步槍決定。

kit.name: 線膛砲
kit.history: 線膛讓同樣的藥量走得更遠。砲兵第一次可以在射程上贏步兵。

countries: 交戰的兩方是希臘王國與鄂圖曼帝國。希臘方面由國王喬治一世在位、迪米特里奧斯·拉利斯內閣主持國政，軍隊最高指揮權交給王儲康斯坦丁，他以總司令兼陸軍部長的頭銜坐鎮色薩利，總參謀部負責制訂集團軍使用、兵站與預備隊調動計畫。前線作戰單位以師為主，每師轄三個步兵團與一個步兵砲兵團，另有營編砲兵與工兵，直屬部隊包括騎兵旅、偵察營、通信連與野戰醫療隊；戰役初期投入色薩利方向的是四個步兵師與一個騎兵師，之後由本土繼續增援，總動員人數達到全國可徵召兵員的相當部分。鄂圖曼方面由蘇丹阿卜杜勒-哈米德二世統御，軍令自君士坦丁堡的大總理會議與總參謀部發出，馬穆德·謝夫凱特帕夏在參謀總部主持作戰計劃，色薩利方向由易卜拉欣·艾德海姆帕夏統率方面軍，克里特方向的軍事長官則在戰事中由哈姆迪帕夏換成舒克魯帕夏。列強並未正式作戰，但俄羅斯、法國、英國與義大利的戰艦編隊於六月抵達達達尼爾海峽，名義是保護本國商船與鄂圖曼海岸，實際上對雙方都構成牽制。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Kingdom of Greece and the Ottoman Empire. On the Greek side, George I was on the throne and a government under Dimitrios Rallis handled state affairs, but military command was handed to Crown Prince Constantine, who acted as commander-in-chief and minister of war while based in Thessaly, with the general staff drawing up the plans for the employment of army groups, supply and the movement of reserves. The operational unit on the battlefield was the division, each with three infantry regiments and an infantry artillery regiment, supplemented by battalion artillery, engineer units, and directly attached troops including a cavalry brigade, reconnaissance companies, a signal company and field medical units. Four infantry divisions and a cavalry division were committed in Thessaly at the outset, with reinforcements streaming in from the homeland, and total mobilization reached a substantial share of the country's available manpower. On the Ottoman side, Sultan Abdülhamid II held supreme authority; orders issued from the grand vizier's council and the general staff in Constantinople, with Mahmud Shevket Pasha running the operations plan at the head of the staff. In Thessaly the field army was commanded by İbrahim Edhem Pasha, while the military governor of Crete changed during the campaign from Hamdi Pasha to Şükrü Pasha. The Great Powers did not formally fight, but squadrons of Russia, France, Britain and Italy reached the Dardanelles in June, nominally to protect their own merchant shipping and the Ottoman coast, and in practice they constrained both sides.
people: 關鍵人物集中在指揮鏈的兩端。希臘這邊，迪米特里奧斯·拉利斯在議會與街頭壓力下批准動員，卻把指揮權交給年僅三十出頭的王儲康斯坦丁；康斯坦丁身兼陸軍部長，人稱「藍色的康斯坦丁」，這綽號來自總參謀部深藍色的軍服，他以近乎示範的旺盛精力在色薩利前線逐個檢視部隊，也是多莫科斯之戰後下令全線追擊、逼迫鄂圖曼軍北撤的關鍵決策者。亞歷山德羅斯·扎伊米斯在一八九六年十月因主張把克里特問題交由俄皇仲裁而辭去總理職務，他雖然不在指揮鏈上，卻是「統一克里特」路線背後的政治推手；埃萊夫塞里奧斯·韋尼澤洛斯在克里特起義中扮演的角色，則說明這場戰爭與島上的衝突從未真正分開。海軍方面，康斯坦丁諾斯·孔圖里奧蒂斯率領巡洋艦與驅逐艦分隊封鎖達達尼爾海峽，被希臘人稱為「博斯普魯斯的斯巴達人」，提莫萊翁·瓦索斯則在克里特與薩摩斯方向指揮登陸。鄂圖曼方面，易卜拉欣·艾德海姆帕夏在拉里薩與多莫科斯之間指揮節節後撤，舒克魯帕夏接手克里特後被指責鎮壓過度；四月科姆尼尼事件中的希臘少尉科姆尼諾斯隨後被送上軍事法庭，成為整場衝突的引爆點人物。
peopleEn: The decisive personalities sat at the two ends of the chain of command. For Greece, Dimitrios Rallis approved the mobilization under parliamentary and street pressure but left the command in the hands of the young Crown Prince Constantine, who was still in his thirties; Constantine also served as minister of war and was nicknamed 'the Blue' after the dark blue uniform of the general staff. He inspected units one by one along the Thessalian front with an almost demonstrative energy, and he was the man who ordered the general pursuit after the battle of Domokos that drove the Ottoman army back north. Alexandros Zaimis had resigned as prime minister in October 1896 after advocating that the Cretan question be submitted to the tsar for arbitration; although he held no command post, he was the political sponsor of the unionist line, and the role of Eleftherios Venizelos in the Cretan revolt shows that this war was never really separate from the island's conflict. At sea, Konstantinos Kountouriotis led cruisers and destroyers in the blockade of the Dardanelles and was called 'the Spartan of the Bosporus', while Timoleon Vassos directed landings in Crete and in the Samos area. On the Ottoman side, İbrahim Edhem Pasha commanded the step-by-step withdrawal between Larissa and Domokos, Şükrü Pasha took over Crete and was accused of excessive repression, and the Greek lieutenant Komninos, involved in the April incident at Komnini, was later tried by a military court, making him the spark that lit the whole conflict.
kits: 卡面兵器是一門一八五〇年德國製造的線膛野戰砲，銅或鋼質砲身，藥室在膛底，後膛靠螺紋壓入的閉塞件密封，有效射程在一千二百步上下；到一八九七年，這類膛口裝填火炮已被後膛式速射砲徹底淘汰，留在現役的只有守備砲隊、要塞與海防單位，以及新兵的訓練器材。戰役中真正決定射程與火力密度的是後膛式鋼砲：希臘軍新購的克魯伯與施耐德-卡內一二〇公厘野戰砲與七五公厘山砲，鄂圖曼軍同樣裝備克魯伯及施耐德-克魯梭各式野戰砲，並配有一五公厘與三〇·五公厘曲射砲。步槍方面，希臘以七·九二公厘曼利查一八八八與一八九〇式為主力，鄂圖曼則是七·六五公厘毛瑟一八八七與一八九〇式，兩邊都還留著上一代的格拉式與佩abody-馬丁尼式步槍作補充。希臘軍是歐洲最早在野戰中使用電話的軍隊之一，本役已在前線師部之間架設野戰電話線，但線路長度有限，僅供師與軍總部之間通訊。雙方也都仍使用十九世紀中葉的野戰臼砲與早期破片手榴彈，其危險性與不可靠程度遠高於後膛砲。運輸方面，希臘由本土把糧秣運到沃洛斯港，再以色薩利鐵路與馬車分送各師；鄂圖曼則倚賴新鋪的薩洛尼卡-色薩利鐵路與大量牛車，軍隊還大量使用馬匹馱運，而希臘騎兵師規模偏小，追擊階段幾乎無法發揮作用。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is a rifled muzzle-loading field gun manufactured in Germany in 1850, with a bronze or steel barrel, the powder chamber at the breech end of the bore and the breech sealed by a threaded closure screw, effective to roughly twelve hundred paces. By 1897 this class of muzzle-loading gun had been completely superseded by quick-firing breech-loaders, and the only ones still in service were garrison artillery, fortress and coastal defence batteries, and the training equipment of new recruits. What actually decided range and density of fire in the campaign were breech-loading steel guns: the Krupp and Schneider-Canet 120 mm field guns and 75 mm mountain guns newly bought by Greece, and the Ottoman army likewise equipped with Krupp and Schneider-Creusot guns of various patterns, together with 15 cm and 30.5 cm howitzers. On the rifle side, Greece relied on the 7.92 mm Mannlicher M1888 and M1890, while the Ottomans used the 7.65 mm Mauser M1887 and M1890, with the previous generation of Gras and Peabody-Martini rifles on hand as auxiliaries in both armies. The Greek army was among the first in Europe to use the field telephone, and in this campaign field telephone lines already ran between divisional headquarters, though the runs were short and served mainly to link division with corps headquarters. Both sides continued to employ mid-nineteenth-century field howitzes and early fragmentation grenades, whose danger and unreliability were far greater than those of the breech-loaders. On logistics, Greece moved grain and ammunition from the homeland to the port of Volos and then distributed it by the Thessaly railway and by cart; the Ottomans relied on the newly built Salonica-Thessaly railway and on large numbers of ox carts, and both armies used pack animals extensively, while the Greek cavalry division was too small to matter during the pursuit.
tactics: 希臘軍的戰術是一八八〇年代以來從德語區學來的散兵線與集團攻勢：步兵以連為單位散開前進，依托村落、土堤與地形起伏射擊，再以營、團為梯次投入；連發步槍的射程與精度讓進攻方在四百米外就能壓制守軍射界，但也迫使進攻縱隊在開闊的色薩利平原上付出很大代價。希臘的弱點在協同：各師之間缺乏可靠的通信連接，攻勢常在同一時間於多個方向同時發起而無法集中兵力，砲兵新裝備到貨較遲，維列斯提諾與卡爾迪察一線在五月之前火力明顯不足，騎兵又少。鄂圖曼軍佔據色薩利平原上的石砌村寨與高地，憑固定陣地與交叉火網拖住希臘攻勢，同時以縱深後衛逐段撤向多莫科斯；六月初從薩洛尼卡運到的三萬後備軍因鐵路運力與渡河瓶頸無法及時展開，隊形在長距離行軍中拉成數列，一遇襲擊即告崩潰。多莫科斯一戰之後，鄂圖曼全線退向色雷索斯山，翻越山口的撤退因道路狹窄、車隊堵塞而演成潰散，丟下大量野戰砲與輜重。卡面那一類舊式膛口砲在這樣的撤退中只能由後方守備分隊零星使用——射速低、射程短，卻能憑一兩門就封住鄉間狹路——野戰交鋒的主導權則已完全交給後膛式速射砲與連發步槍。
tacticsEn: The Greek manner of fighting was the skirmish line and the group attack imported from the German-speaking world in the 1880s: infantry advanced dispersed by company, firing from villages, earthworks and broken ground, and then fed in battalion and regiment by echelon. The range and accuracy of the repeating rifles allowed an attacker to dominate the defenders' field of fire from four hundred metres, but that also forced the attacking columns to pay a heavy price on the open ground of the Thessalian plain. The weakness was coordination: links between divisions were unreliable, offensives were often launched simultaneously in several directions instead of being concentrated, and newly bought artillery arrived too late, so that firepower was visibly short along the Velestino and Carditsa lines before May; the cavalry was also too few. The Ottoman army occupied the stone-built villages and heights of the Thessalian plain, holding the Greek attack with fixed positions and interlocking fields of fire while a depth guard withdrew by stages towards Domokos. The thirty thousand reservists sent from Salonica in early June could not be deployed in time because of railway capacity and the bottlenecks at the river crossings, and after days on the march their formations had stretched out into columns that broke at the first contact. After the battle of Domokos the entire Ottoman line withdrew towards the range of Mount Ossa, and the retreat over the mountain passes degenerated into a rout because the roads were narrow and the wagon trains blocked them, abandoning field guns and baggage on the way. The old muzzle-loading gun of the card could only be used in dribs and drabs by rear-guard detachments in such a withdrawal: slow-firing and short-ranged, but able to seal a narrow country lane with one or two pieces. Command of the field engagement had passed entirely to the breech-loading quick-firers and the repeating rifles.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下：希臘全國動員兵力約十四萬，其中投入色薩利作戰的方面軍約七萬五千至八萬，編為四至五個步兵師、一個騎兵師與直屬工兵、醫療、通信部隊，戰役初期實際在第一線的約四萬五千人；鄂圖曼在色薩利原有約三萬至四萬，六月自薩洛尼卡運入約三萬後備軍，總投入約六萬至七萬。色薩利戰鬥自一八九七年四月十八日開打，至六月中旬多莫科斯之戰後全線崩退，歷時約兩個月，戰役的最後一階段是希臘軍追擊與佔領伊奧尼納、普雷韋扎與阿爾塔，行動延續到七月十九日；九月二十四日在君士坦丁堡簽訂初步和約，十二月十二日簽訂正式和約。傷亡方面，各家估計出入頗大，大致是希臘方陣亡約一千至一千五百人、受傷約兩千至三千，鄂圖曼方陣亡與重傷合計約四千至六千，被俘超過兩千。距離與補給方面，希臘本土到前線約四百公里，靠海運至沃洛斯再轉火車，色薩利境內的鐵路運輸線約一百公里；多莫科斯到拉里薩約六十公里，兩地之間是鄂圖曼軍節節防守與撤退的主要走廊。財政上，希臘靠加徵特別稅與本國貸款籌措戰費，戰後國家債務明顯上升，翌年仍須向倫敦市場借款以更新軍備。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are roughly as follows. Greece mobilized about 140,000 men in all, of whom some 75,000 to 80,000 were committed in Thessaly, formed into four or five infantry divisions, a cavalry division and directly attached engineer, medical and signal troops; about 45,000 were actually in the front line at the beginning of the campaign. The Ottomans had between 30,000 and 40,000 in Thessaly to begin with and brought in about 30,000 reservists from Salonica in June, for a total commitment of some 60,000 to 70,000. The fighting in Thessaly opened on 18 April 1897 and came to an end with the collapse of the Ottoman line after the battle of Domokos in mid-June, a span of about two months, while the last phase, the Greek pursuit and the occupation of Ioannina, Preveza and Arta, ran on until 19 July. Preliminary peace was signed at Constantinople on 24 September and the final peace treaty on 12 December. Casualty estimates vary considerably between sources, but roughly Greece lost 1,000 to 1,500 dead and 2,000 to 3,000 wounded, while the Ottoman side lost between 4,000 and 6,000 dead and severely wounded, with more than 2,000 taken prisoner. On distances and supply, the Greek homeland lay about 400 kilometres from the front, reached by sea to Volos and then by rail, while the railway inside Thessaly ran about 100 kilometres; the road from Domokos to Larissa is some 60 kilometres and was the corridor along which the Ottomans fought and withdrew step by step. Financially, Greece met the cost of the war with special taxes and domestic loans; the public debt rose markedly afterwards, and the government still had to borrow in the London market the following year to re-equip the army.
cause: 這場戰爭的起因是克里特問題與色薩利邊界糾纏在一起。一八九六年，克里特起義者推翻奧斯曼總督府，宣布與希臘「統一」，歐洲列強出兵干預，希臘總理扎伊米斯因主張把克里特交由俄皇仲裁而辭職，國內主戰呼聲轉高；與此同時，鄂圖曼在克里特與馬其頓大量徵召後備軍，色薩利邊境上的兵員與鐵路部署明顯增加。希臘則在違反一八八一年希土條約與一八八六年公約的限兵條款下秘密擴軍，常備兵額遠超條約上限。兩者之間還夾雜著希臘對色薩利與伊庇魯斯失地、對克里特少數族裔的民族訴求，以及巴爾幹同盟體系下保加利亞與塞爾維亞局勢的牽動。一八九七年四月二十六日夜至二十七日，希臘游擊隊在馬其頓的科姆尼尼襲擊鄂圖曼一支小哨，約二十餘名鄂圖曼士兵陣亡、一名軍官被俘，這一事件立刻被鄂圖曼朝廷當作開戰口實；希臘政府否認指使，但既沒有交還被俘軍官，也沒有足夠力量約束前線的小股武裝。面對邊境衝突不斷升級，國王與內閣於四月十八日（儒略曆）下令全軍越過邊界，色薩利戰役就此揭幕。
causeEn: The origin of the war lay in the entanglement of the Cretan question with the frontier of Thessaly. In 1896 the Cretan insurgents overthrew the Ottoman administration and proclaimed union with Greece; European powers intervened, and the Greek prime minister Zaimis resigned after proposing that Crete be settled by tsarist arbitration, while inside Greece the cry for war grew louder. At the same time the Ottomans called up large numbers of reservists in Crete and Macedonia and visibly reinforced the frontier in Thessaly, where troops and the railway were increased. Greece, meanwhile, expanded the army in secret in breach of the troop limits laid down by the 1881 Greek-Turkish treaty and the 1886 convention, keeping a peacetime establishment far above the ceiling agreed. Between the two causes sat the Greek national case for the lost lands of Thessaly and Epirus, the Greek minority in Crete, and the pull of the Balkan alliance system on Bulgaria and Serbia. On the night of 26 to 27 April 1897, Greek irregulars struck an Ottoman picket at Komnini in Macedonia, killing of the order of twenty or more Ottoman soldiers and taking an officer prisoner, and the Ottoman court immediately seized on the episode as a casus belli. The Greek government denied ordering it, but neither handed the captured officer back nor had the strength to restrain the small armed bands in the front line. With frontier clashes escalating, the king and his cabinet ordered the army across the frontier on 18 April (Julian calendar), and the Thessalian campaign opened.
impact: 戰爭的結果把希臘的「統一克里特」目標擱置了將近半個世紀：一八九八年克里特改組為自治克里特邦，由希臘王子喬治出任高等專員，列強派駐代表監督，統一議題要等一九一三年第二次希土戰爭之後才有條件重提。希臘國內則因這場勝利而付出了財政與軍制的代價——軍隊雖勝，裝備落後的真相暴露無遺，總參謀部在一八九八至一九〇四年間重整，砲兵與後勤部門獲得優先補充，野戰電話與鐵路運輸被制度化，德國軍事顧問團隨後進駐整頓；瓦索斯與孔圖里奧蒂斯這批前線指揮官則成為新政黨崛起後的軍界核心。反過來看，鄂圖曼的敗績同樣推動了本國軍隊的近代化，阿里夫帕夏與德國教練團在戰後主導整編，而列強在達達尼爾海峽的集結也讓君士坦丁堡明白，帝國在歐洲的存續越來越依賴英俄之間的平衡與列強的護航。巴爾幹局勢未因此緩和：馬其頓的改革要求在戰後被提上日程，一九〇四年保加利亞的起義正是這些要求長期累積的結果，而一九〇八年希臘青年在哈爾基季基半島的起義，則直接沿用了一八九七年這套民族主義動員的方式。
impactEn: The outcome shelved the Greek aim of union with Crete for nearly half a century: in 1898 Crete was reorganized as an autonomous Cretan state, with the Greek prince George as high commissioner and representatives of the powers supervising, and the union question could not be revived until conditions allowed after the Second Balkan War of 1913. Inside Greece the victory carried a fiscal and institutional price — the army won, yet the truth about its obsolete equipment was laid bare. The general staff was reorganized between 1898 and 1904, artillery and the supply services were given priority in re-equipment, the field telephone and railway transport were institutionalized, and a German military mission arrived afterwards to reorganize the army; Vassos, Kountouriotis and the other front-line commanders of 1897 became the core of the officer corps that the rising new parties would later rely on. The Ottoman defeat was no less a stimulus to modernization at home, with the German training mission and the reform staff taking charge of the reorganization in the years around the turn of the century, and the concentration of the powers in the Dardanelles taught Constantinople that the empire's survival in Europe increasingly depended on the Anglo-Russian balance and on foreign escort. The Balkan situation did not thereby calm: demands for reform in Macedonia came onto the agenda after the war, and the Bulgarian uprising of 1904 grew directly out of that accumulated grievance, while the Greek youth rising of 1908 on the Chalcidice peninsula drew openly on the same methods of national mobilization used in 1897.
result: 色薩利平原上的軍事結果是清楚的：希臘軍逐退鄂圖曼方面軍，佔領拉里薩以北的整片平原，攻入伊奧尼納、普雷韋扎與阿爾塔，鄂圖曼軍退守色雷索斯山與色薩利北界；鄂圖曼分艦隊被封鎖在達達尼爾海峽，直到一九一二年才重新取得出海權。希臘雖然贏了戰爭，卻沒能贏到克里特：九月二十四日的初步和約與十二月十二日的君士坦丁堡正式和約確認希臘放棄「統一」路線，克里特另行自治，馬其頓只得到原則性的自治承諾，而俄羅斯、法國與義大利（其後英國亦加入）轉為保證希臘領土完整的國際角色。代價同樣明顯：希臘為此背上一筆戰後債務，軍隊未經整編便繼續擴張；鄂圖曼在色薩利損失數千人、丟棄大批火砲與輜重，士氣與財政都受重創，這正是本國軍隊在世紀之交全面整頓的起點。就卡面兵器而言，那門一八五〇年的線膛野戰砲自此退出一線序列，戰役的火線改由克魯伯與施耐德-卡內的鋼製後膛砲、以及七·九二與七·六五公厘的連發步槍接管；它在這場戰爭裡的位置，是舊世代火砲退場的註腳。
resultEn: The military outcome on the Thessalian plain is unambiguous: the Greek army drove the Ottoman field army out, occupied the whole plain north of Larissa, and entered Ioannina, Preveza and Arta, while the Ottoman forces fell back to the range of Mount Ossa and the northern boundary of Thessaly. The Ottoman squadron was shut into the Dardanelles and did not regain passage to the open sea until 1912. Greece had won the war but not Crete: the preliminary agreement of 24 September and the final peace treaty of Constantinople on 12 December confirmed that Greece would drop the union line, that Crete would be separately autonomous, and that Macedonia would receive only a nominal promise of autonomy, while Russia, France and Italy — Britain later joining them — turned into guarantors of the territorial integrity of Greece. The costs were equally visible: Greece took on a war debt and expanded the army before the reorganization was complete, while the Ottomans in Thessaly lost several thousand men and abandoned large quantities of guns and baggage, damaging both morale and the treasury, and that defeat became the starting point of the wholesale military reorganization carried out around the turn of the century. As for the weapon on the card, the 1850 rifled muzzle-loading field gun left the first-line order of battle for good, and the fire of the battle passed to Krupp and Schneider-Canet steel breech-loaders and to the 7.92 and 7.65 mm repeating rifles. In this war its role was that of a footnote on the retirement of the old generation of artillery.
